purpose: Test whether delaying the second bounded lifetime credit by one complete intervening scheduling window preserves a reachable second credit while avoiding V166's immediate-next-window release.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

frozen_evidence.v158_interpretation: broad short-work overlap passed QPR means but failed throughput pairing
frozen_evidence.v165_mechanism_interpretation: requiring zero outstanding speculation made the second credit operationally negligible; performance remained sealed

v166_result_blind_mechanism.interpretation: V166's aggregate sequence is consistent with immediate-next-window second-credit release; performance was not revealed

single_mechanism_change_from_v166.credit: retain the hard cumulative cap of two speculative admissions per request
single_mechanism_change_from_v166.identity_level_age_state: record the successful first-credit admission frame per request
single_mechanism_change_from_v166.second_credit_guard: the second credit requires current_frame minus first_credit_frame at least two scheduling windows and current outstanding incomplete-parent nonterminal speculation at most one
single_mechanism_change_from_v166.same_window_guard: at most one credit candidate per request is admitted in a scheduling window
single_mechanism_change_from_v166.selection_order: maximum immutable critical-path rank then minimum function ID
unchanged: first V163 credit eligibility and consumption point after successful command send
SRPT request order and critical-path rank definition
V163 Hiku2/OCS placement router and all player scores
NSESche solver, welfare, pricing and feasibility
common HPA, tapes, metrics and policy-independent references

aged_dual_lifetime_credit_definition.first_credit: exact V163 eligibility and deterministic candidate; store the successful admission frame only after the command batch is sent
aged_dual_lifetime_credit_definition.second_credit: same eligibility and deterministic candidate, additionally requiring first credit consumed, second unused, identity-level age at least two windows and outstanding at most one
aged_dual_lifetime_credit_definition.consumption: only after the actual scheduling command batch is successfully sent
aged_dual_lifetime_credit_definition.request_retirement: first frame and both credit states are forgotten only after the request leaves the live request map
forbidden_inputs: fitted function IDs, node IDs, frame cutoffs or admission counts

checks: exact E09, E18 and E20 product/order with no additional seed or baseline
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing
V163 frontier thresholds request ordering and placement scores remain unchanged except the sealed aged-dual-credit frontier name
at least one first credit is consumed
at least one otherwise eligible second-credit candidate is blocked only because identity-level age is below two windows
at least one second credit is subsequently consumed at identity-level age at least two windows
every second credit has first-credit state, age at least two and outstanding at most one before admission
cumulative admissions never exceed two per request and projected outstanding speculation never exceeds two
at most one lifetime-credit player per request is selected in any window
credit and first-frame state conserve across live-request retention and successful command sends
both below-8 and at-or-above-8 routes occur
zero performance or aggregate outcome fields are parsed before audit sealing
result_blind_audit.cap_exhausted_rejection_is_not_a_breadth: the lifetime cap is verified directly by state conservation, zero repeat-admission violations, production tests and projected limits
result_blind_audit.outstanding_block_is_not_a_breadth_requi: V167 isolates timing; the outstanding limit remains an invariant but its rejection path need not occur in three seeds

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V155 E09, E18 and E20 with V167 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins, including at least 2 of 3 diagnostic wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both QPR conventions strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins with 20 of 20 finite-only values
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all three valid V167 diagnostics, retire V167 and do not run its other seventeen seeds
diagnostic_selection_rule.success: authorize a separately committed remaining-seventeen V167 training plan reusing these three rows
